## Summary

Describe the skill or foundation change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] I reviewed the complete `SKILL.md`.
- [ ] I inspected every bundled script.
- [ ] I documented dependencies, network access, and destructive behavior.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, customer data, or internal-only content.
- [ ] I updated the version and review dates in `docs/SKILL-LIFECYCLE.md`.
- [ ] Security review is complete or not applicable.
- [ ] Privacy, Legal, and People review is complete or not applicable.

## Testing

List the prompts and supported agents used to test this change.

## Publishing

If this changes a public skill, identify the matching Lattice Skills Library
page and publish both from the same merged version.
